function cov(d::MultivariateMixture)
    K = ncomponents(d)
    p = probs(d)
    m = zeros(length(d))
    md = zeros(length(d))
    V = zeros(length(d),length(d))

    for i = 1:K
        pi = p[i]
        if pi > 0.0
            c = component(d, i)
            axpy!(pi, mean(c), m)
            axpy!(pi, cov(c), V)
        end
    end
    for i = 1:K
        pi = p[i]
        if pi > 0.0
            c = component(d, i)
            md .= mean(c) .- m
            BLAS.syr!('U', Float64(pi), md, V)
        end
    end
    LinearAlgebra.copytri!(V, 'U')
    return V
end
